reviews.prop-countable-unions-and-subsets-of-man: Reviewed on the repaired text. The statement now exposes Countable Choice; subsets are handled chartwise, and the union proof spends that choice exactly when selecting one cube cover for each set. The N-by-N enumeration and geometric budgets give a single countable cover of total volume at most epsilon. The zero-dimensional convention is inherited from the preceding detector and introduces no omitted case.
reviews.lem-sard-slicing-for-compact-null-sectio: Reviewed every boundary and estimate on the repaired text. The degenerate interval a=b is handled as a lower-dimensional hyperplane. For a<b, compact sections give finite open cube covers, compactness gives the local interval control, the Lebesgue number produces a finite subordinate partition, and the prism subdivision has total volume bounded by the sum of the partition lengths. The final epsilon estimate is strict and covers all of K.
